messages:
Maria M.: Heads-up — post-launch webinar + three product launch posts went live this morning. I'm seeing a +48% spike in raw leads but the Dash shows most of the lift attributed to ‘direct / none’. Anyone else seeing the source split?
Prateek: Saw it too. Dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/launch-ops (quick view). Looks like UTM parsing dropped for about ~45% of new leads.
Olivia (DS): analytics-bot just flagged GA4 ingestion anomalies at 09:12. Might be a sampling/ingestion lag between GA4 -> ETL. digging.
analytics-bot: [alert] GA4 export latency increased for property project-redwood-web at 09:15, ~2.8x normal. Backfill started.
Jamal: Could also be our shorter redirect from /r/launch -> full URL losing utm params sometimes. Saw one redirect rule change in nginx that strips query on 301.
Maria M.: Ugh. That redirect tweak was by infra last week for caching. @Olivia can you confirm if the accounts are showing page_location without querystrings?
Olivia (DS): quick check — sample rows: 
```
user_id: a3f2
page_location: https://redwood.ai/launch-posts
page_referrer: https://t.co/somepromo
utm_source: null
```
so yes, querystrings missing on a subset. I can run cohort to see if missing utms correlate with specific campaigns.
Prateek: If UTMs are gone, marketing attribution will default to direct in our looker logic. We should tag those leads as "manual review" in the interim for quality checks.
Jamal: Short-term ops: roll back the nginx redirect rule for /r/launch. I can put a canary to 5% in 10 mins. Anyone object? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maria M.: Do it. Also we need to surface how lead quality compares — open rate / MQL rate — for the UTMs present vs direct. Can Olivia slice that?
Olivia (DS): Yup — will run a quick pivot: `leads -> utm_presence -> qualified_rate` and post numbers in 20m. If rollback looks ok, we'll re-ingest backfill and re-eval attribution.
Prateek: FYI for the weekly KPI review tomorrow — let's include an annotation about the temporary redirect-caused attribution noise and present both pre-backfill and post-backfill metrics.
Maria M.: Good call. Jamal, after the canary, DM me the rollout plan and I'll add to the canvas for tomorrow's KPI meeting. :memo:
Jamal: Canary started at 09:28 to 5% traffic. Monitoring nginx logs and conversion funnel. Will update at 09:34.
analytics-bot: [info] Backfill job for GA4 -> warehouse queued (job id: bf-2026-03-23-09-31).
Olivia (DS): Preliminary pivot: UTMs present cohort (n=420) MQL rate 8.3%; UTMs missing cohort (n=380) MQL rate 6.0%. Looks like quality delta exists — we'll watch if backfill changes numbers.
Maria M.: Thanks. For the KPI doc: add a slide with the before/after attr split + note about short-term lead quality bias. Also propose we tighten redirect tests in staging to avoid this in future.
Prateek: I'll add a quick analytics query to flag future drops where >15% of launch traffic loses utm params.
Jamal: Canary 5% -> stable for 6 minutes with no error spike, increasing to 25% now. Will revert immediately if any anomaly.
Maria M.: Perfect. Keep this thread updated and I'll draft the KPI note. :thumbsup:
